description: Audit a web page's SEO and sharing tags in one call: title and meta description (with lengths), canonical, robots/noindex, lang, viewport, H1/H2 headings, word count, image alt text, internal/external links, Open Graph and Twitter cards, hreflang and schema.org types, plus a plain-English list of issues and a score. Use when reviewing or fixing a page for search or social previews. Errors: 400 bad or private URL, 502 site error. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).
name: seo_page_audit
